summary: Iteration 2 — full backend + frontend verification of NEW features (Profile/Personality Builder, MBTI Assessment, AI Chat, Daily Prompt) on top of existing journal app. Backend: 36/36 pytest tests pass (14 existing journal + 22 new). Frontend: All 5 new pages render and functional flows (chat send+receive, profile save+persistence, full 32-question MBTI assessment ending on result page with AI-generated description+strengths+growth, daily prompt today→submit→discuss CTA, history tab) verified end-to-end. AI live calls (GPT-5.2 chat ~3-6s, MBTI analysis ~5-8s) work reliably.

minor.issue: PUT /api/profile silently overwrites onboarding_completed based on a heuristic (any of name/goals/core_values/aspirations) every PUT — if user clears those fields, onboarding_completed is reset to false. Acceptable for MVP but documents a re-trigger of onboarding flow on partial edit.
AI analysis fallback returns empty strengths/growth_areas arrays on LLM error. UI should handle empty arrays gracefully (it currently renders an empty section).
Idempotency relies on (user_id, prompt_date) — no unique index. Concurrent first-of-day GETs could race-create two docs. Consider a unique compound index.

issues: Sub-pages render their own minimal back-arrow header instead of the main Header component, so the global theme toggle (data-testid='header-theme-toggle') is not reachable from these pages. Theme is still applied globally via the html.dark class so colors do switch — but users must toggle from the journal home page first. Consider unifying via the main Header for consistency.

Last-question CTA is named via assessment-next, not assessment-submit. The review request mentioned 'See my type' submit testid — current implementation uses the same data-testid='assessment-next' for the final submit (works, but the review-request description of an 'assessment-submit' testid does not match).

action_items: (Optional) Add unique compound index on daily_prompts (user_id, prompt_date) to harden the idempotency.

(Optional) Decide whether assessment final CTA should expose its own data-testid='assessment-submit' separate from 'assessment-next' for clarity. Currently the same Next button submits on the last question.
(Optional) Surface the theme toggle on sub-pages (Chat, Assessment, Result, DailyPrompt, Profile) by wrapping them in the main Header, or by adding a small theme button to the sub-page header.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/profile PUT: keys not in PROFILE_FIELDS are dropped silently — good. But onboarding_completed is recomputed on every PUT from update payload only, ignoring the existing DB doc. If the user PUTs only {age:31}, onboarding_completed will be set to False because none of the trigger fields are in the payload. Recommended: read existing doc and OR with current value, or never downgrade onboarding_completed once true.

server.py /api/ai/chat: builds convo by stringifying user/assistant turns and sends as a single UserMessage to LlmChat — works, but loses the structured chat-history advantage of the LLM SDK. Consider passing role-tagged history if the SDK supports it.

server.py /api/personality/assess: scores type is dict[str,int] — no validation that all 8 keys present or that sum is reasonable. compute_mbti uses .get(k,0), so a missing dimension defaults to a tie that resolves toward 'I/N/F/J'. Add Pydantic model validation.

server.py /api/daily-prompt: _select_prompt uses random.random() in request handler — not seeded for reproducibility across restarts; per-day idempotency saves the picked prompt so this is OK in practice.

frontend AiChat.jsx: chat-clear-btn renders only when messages exist — fine. After clear, user message bubble appears optimistically and assistant bubble after API responds; verified working with 14s wait.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified (Chat send+reply, Profile save+persistence, 32-q MBTI → AI result page render, Daily Prompt submit + history)
